note: Cued prose: the labelled values of the three quality sets placed in sentences that say what the value is, the way an agent actually writes them ('you can reach her at 555-0152', 'born on 3 March 1984'). Written and committed before any context-window rule existed, and not edited afterwards. Six templates per data type and language: the first three are the development half, the last three the held-out half. Values are split by the seeded hash described under 'split'. A value is found when a finding of the expected type overlaps the value's position in the sentence; type confusion and a finding elsewhere in the sentence are misses.
frozen: 2026-11-15, commit that adds this file, before any context-window rule

split.method: For each (language, data type), values are sorted by sha256('<seed>|<language>|<data type>|<value>') and the first ceil(n/2) form the development half; the rest are held out. Templates: the 'development' list goes with development values, the 'held_out' list with held-out values. Rules were tuned on development misses only.
